about: World channels of the build: free channels from the broadcasters' own public streams or their own free ad-supported feeds. No restream servers, no paid channels, no tokens. Every row is played to its first segment by src/qa/check_channels.py before it is listed; read by resources/lib/livefail.py world() and merged into the TV list by resources/lib/iptv.py add_world().
